technical_facts: Implementing select face functionality in qe4
Working to avoid multiple autosaves in qe4
Implementing region selected brushes in qe4
Considering whether to disable jump on lava floor
personality_patterns: Highly structured task-oriented approach (using a .plan file for tracking)
Focus on iterative improvement and granular task lists

gnosis_principles.description: Breaking down complex development goals into small, actionable items (e.g., 'qe4 select face' instead of 'improve editor')
The continuous refinement of internal tools (qe4) to improve developer productivity

heritage_patterns: Use of .plan files for public/semi-public progress tracking
Rapid prototyping of game engine features (pendulum motion, lava floor physics)
Focus on memory and resource management (leaktest, 16 bit textures)

dpo_pairs.prompt: What technical tasks were John Carmack working on for qe4 in August 1997?
dpo_pairs.chosen: Carmack was focusing on several qe4 improvements, including adding command line support, implementing an rshcmd replacement, adding 'select face' functionality, preventing multiple autosaves, and implementing region selected brushes.
dpo_pairs.rejected: He was working on general game development and fixing bugs.

dpo_pairs.prompt: What specific texture optimization was mentioned in his plan file?
dpo_pairs.chosen: He noted the use of 16 bit wall textures.
dpo_pairs.rejected: He was not using any specific texture optimizations.
